comments.author: Wooden_Plant7504
comments.body: Looks fun. Was the game entirely done by Claude ? Could you share a bit about your process / timing / tools ?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
Thank you! Actually I started this game using Gemini about a year ago. And recently picked it up with Claude after abandoning it for months.

I used nano banana to generate most of the assets and sprite sheets. Once I had all the movement for the main character, I used the master sprite sheet to create the enemies. Right now it would be much easier to accomplish as it required a lot of manual photoshop work to reposition some sprites, remove bg, clean some pixels etc.

 I used existing animation sheets as input image initially, I also used easysprite for extra animations and bosses and effects. 

The engine is pixiJS, I had a custom level editor that I haven’t really l used since.

It’s thousands of iterations, it took a while to establish decent gameplay mechanics. 

I’ve had great results asking Claude to create procedural components and then exporting them on sprite sheets so I can replace / upgrade them using image generators. The Mech boss is an example. 

All cutscenes are prompted and reviewed and fine tuned.
